q2_prompt_sql: SELECT CLASS FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(2)>=5
explanation: COUNT(*) counts all rows in the group, while COUNT(2) (interpreted as COUNT(CLASS) in this context) counts only non-null values of CLASS. When CLASS contains NULLs, these counts differ, causing Q1 and Q2 to return different results.
counterexample_dsp: Insert 5 rows with NULL CLASS and 6 rows with 'History' CLASS. Q1 includes NULL (5 rows) while Q2 excludes it (COUNT(CLASS) = 0 for NULL group).
